extra: HERON (<IMAGE_2>) and WOLFHOUND (<IMAGE_3>) on the border bridge; the microfilm canister in HERON's hand.
camera: Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera

beats.text: At 2 s, HERON slides the microfilm canister along the bridge parapet to WOLFHOUND.
At 6 s, WOLFHOUND pockets it and walks off without a word.
